blurb: Guests fish for walleye, crappie, smallmouth bass, northern pike, and lake sturgeon on the St. Croix River with expert local guides. Trips include full-day walleye fishing, ice fishing in heated tents, and sturgeon fishing on a climate-controlled party barge. All gear and bait are provided, and guides offer instruction during the trips.

Words honestly can’t describe how incredible our charter fishing trip with Ryan was. His expert knowledge and calm confidence made the day unforgettable — the kind you replay long after it’s over. Our time on the water was truly supercalifragilisticexpialidocious. Immaculate vibes, nonstop fun, and a guide who clearly knows his stuff. If you’re considering a charter, stop thinking and book with Ryan. We’re already planning our next trip. You won’t regret it.

Ryan is an excellent guide and a lot of fun to be on the water with. We caught walleye, Sagar, small mouth, and a big surgeon that we released successfully. His boat is excellent, roomie and comfortable. He has a great sense of humor. I come up here once a year at least to see my daughter‘s family. I’m from Texas Gulf Coast. God willing I plan on booking Ryan whenever I come up from now on.
